offer.text: One of my kin went missing near the old mineshaft and no one's dared look. You're brave enough — search the tunnels and bring me any sign of them.

accept.text: Thank you. Take a torch, and mind the drops.

decline.text: Then they stay lost, and I stay haunted by it.

in_progress.text: Have you reached the old tunnels yet?

ready.text: You went down into the dark for us? Tell me what you found.

complete.text: Whatever the tunnels held, at least we know now. That's a mercy in itself. Thank you for looking.
